# Copilot Instructions for ROOME

## Repository Overview
ROOME is a project currently in its initial setup phase. This repository follows standard Node.js/JavaScript project conventions.

## Project Structure
```
.
├── .github/                # GitHub configuration and workflows
├── .gitignore             # Git ignore patterns for Node.js projects
└── README.md              # Project documentation
```

## Development Guidelines

### Code Style and Conventions
- Follow standard JavaScript/Node.js best practices
- Use consistent indentation (2 or 4 spaces)
- Write clear, descriptive variable and function names
- Add comments for complex logic or non-obvious code

### Dependencies
- When adding new dependencies, use npm or yarn consistently
- Keep dependencies up to date
- Document any new dependencies in the README if they require special setup

### Git Workflow
- Write clear, descriptive commit messages
- Keep commits focused and atomic
- Reference issue numbers in commits when applicable

### Testing
- Add tests for new features
- Ensure all tests pass before committing
- Follow existing test patterns in the repository

### Documentation
- Update README.md when adding new features
- Document API endpoints, configuration options, and setup instructions
- Keep documentation in sync with code changes
